title: Tech Trends 2016: Innovating in the digital era
notes: 'Deloitte’s seventh Technology Trends report, our annual in-depth examination of eight trends that are likely to disrupt businesses in the next 18–24 months.' Eight chapters, the last being 'Social impact of exponential technologies' (counted among the eight). Quotes are from each chapter's opening abstract. The exponentials chapter says several former exponentials (AR/VR, IoT, blockchain) got their own chapters 'as their mass adoption window has moved into the next 18 to 24 months'. Read from the Wayback Machine copy of the Deloitte Global PDF. Published month not stated.

entries.label: Right-speed IT
entries.quote: A growing number of CIOs are building capabilities that link the two edge points or operate along the continuum, with targeted investments in process, technology, and talent to reengineer the business of IT, enabling delivery at the right speed for the business.
entries.subject: IT delivery models (bimodal / right-speed IT)
entries.note: Chapter subtitle: 'Living between black and white'.

entries.label: Augmented and virtual reality go to work
entries.quote: While the consumer world waits for the dominant AR and VR players to emerge, the enterprise can fast-track adoption—and begin the process of fundamentally reimagining how work gets done.
entries.subject: Augmented and virtual reality in the enterprise
entries.note: Chapter subtitle: 'Seeing business through a different lens'. The chapter cites a third-party projection of a US$150 billion AR/VR market by 2020 (Digi-Capital); not recorded as a value.

entries.label: Internet of Things: From sensing to doing
entries.quote: Increasingly, forward-thinking organizations are focusing their Internet of Things (IoT) initiatives less on underlying sensors, devices, and “smart” things and more on developing bold approaches for managing data, leveraging “brownfield” IoT infrastructure, and developing new business models.
entries.subject: Internet of Things
entries.note: Chapter subtitle: 'Think big, start small, scale fast'.

entries.label: Reimagining core systems
entries.quote: For this reason, organizations are now developing strategies for reimagining their core systems that involve re-platforming, modernizing, and revitalizing them.
entries.subject: Core system modernization
entries.note: Chapter subtitle: 'Modernizing the heart of the business'.

entries.label: Autonomic platforms
entries.quote: IT may soon become a self-managing service provider without technical limitations of capacity, performance, and scale.
entries.subject: Autonomic IT platforms (DevOps, containers, software-defined infrastructure)
entries.note: Chapter subtitle: 'Building blocks for labor-less IT'.

entries.label: Blockchain: Democratized trust
entries.quote: Like the Internet reinvented communication, blockchain may similarly disrupt transactions, contracts, and trust—the underpinnings of business, government, and society.
entries.subject: Blockchain
entries.note: Chapter subtitle: 'Distributed ledgers and the future of value'.

entries.label: Industrialized analytics
entries.quote: Indeed, they are treating data analysis as a strategic discipline and investing in industrial-grade analytics.
entries.subject: Enterprise analytics at scale
entries.note: Chapter subtitle: 'Data is the new oil. Where are the refineries?'

entries.label: Social impact of exponential technologies
entries.quote: Harnessing exponentials for social impact can help build markets, drive adoption, and light a powerful beacon for attracting and retaining top talent.
entries.subject: Social impact and ethics of exponential technologies
